depiction_rules.notes: D027 supporting groups; keep each scene to a small, varied and legible set.

visual_bible.form: natural adult humanoids with one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet each
visual_bible.appearance: varied distinct faces, hair and simple cream/saffron/olive garments; restrained crowns only for named leaders
visual_bible.grouping: small purposeful groups; no cloned repeated faces

anatomy_contract.rule: named deities follow their own D027 contracts

never: no fused bodies or duplicate copies
no cloned faces or unreadable crowd
identity_scope: D027 scene continuity only; not an approved character master
